raw.excerpt: About Us: Headquartered in Dallas, Texas, Divcon delivers fully integrated automation solutions nationwide that optimize performance, energy efficiency, and reliability across HVAC, lighting, power monitoring, and mission-critical systems.
raw.description:
About Us:

Headquartered in Dallas, Texas, Divcon delivers fully integrated automation solutions nationwide that optimize performance, energy efficiency, and reliability across HVAC, lighting, power monitoring, and mission-critical systems. Leveraging advanced technologies - including Allen-Bradley PLCs, Ignition SCADA, and Delta DDC systems - we combine deep technical expertise with field-tested execution to deliver precise, scalable, and high-performance solutions.

About the role:

The Senior Applications Engineer provides advanced technical support, application development, integration, troubleshooting, and quality review for DDC/BMS/BAS control system projects. This role supports complex BAS network configuration, gateway integration, customer-facing technical discussions, portfolio standards, and issue resolution for active and existing sites.

This position requires mature judgment, technical depth, independent problem-solving, and the ability to mentor others while supporting consistent, high-quality department output. The Senior Applications Engineer also performs the core responsibilities of the Applications Engineer role while preparing for broader technical leadership responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities:

Advanced Technical Application & Integration

  • Troubleshoot and assist with BMS network setup, configuration, connectivity, and related system issues.
  • Create gateway configurations used between Modbus and BACnet networks.
  • Develop and support control system databases, interfaces, programming, and related deliverables for sequences of operation and project requirements.
  • Provide customer-requested changes, updates, and enhancements to existing databases and application files.
  • Support Service Teams with issues on existing sites and older projects, including technical investigation and resolution recommendations.

Technical Leadership & Quality Review

  • Review standards across portfolios and help ensure consistent, high-quality output across assigned work.
  • Attend and provide technical input as needed in customer-facing meetings.
  • Support, coach, and guide Applications Engineers and Associate Application Engineers on technical tasks, documentation, and project workflows.
  • Shadow and collaborate with the Lead Applications Engineer to learn direction, workflow management, and leadership practices.

Project Execution & Department Support

  • Debug installation issues during static and dynamic start-up and commissioning of building controls and special systems.
  • Provide input to sales staff as requested or required to assist in accurate estimation, design, installation, start-up, commissioning, and training for building systems.
  • Communicate technical risks, missing information, status updates, and required decisions to appropriate stakeholders in a timely manner.
  • Maintain organized project documentation, revisions, database support materials, and technical notes throughout the project lifecycle.

Qualifications:

  • Working knowledge of commercial HVAC, building automation systems (BAS), DDC/BMS controls, and related control sequences.
  • Ability to read and interpret project specifications, sequences of operation, drawings, equipment submittals, and controls documentation.
  • Familiarity with BACnet and Modbus communication protocols and BAS network concepts.
  • Clear understanding of computer and BAS networks, including device addressing, connectivity, and troubleshooting fundamentals.
  • Strong analytical, technical problem-solving, communication, organization, and time-management skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced project environment while maintaining a high degree of integrity and accountability.
  • Experience with Delta Controls preferred; experience with Reliable Controls, KMC, Siemens, or similar product lines is a plus.
  • Experience with EPMS integration, MSA FieldServer Protonode, Python, JavaScript, or other line-based coding is a plus.

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience programming BAS/DDC systems and integrating with third-party equipment preferred.
  • Advanced troubleshooting experience with BAS networks, BACnet, Modbus, gateway configuration, commercial HVAC systems, and commissioning support preferred.
  • Experience with mission-critical sites, data center environments, EPMS integration, Delta Controls, Reliable Controls, KMC, Siemens, or similar product lines strongly preferred.

Benefits & Total Rewards:

  • Opportunities for Growth

Hands-on training and career advancement in an exploding data-center industry.

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

We cover 100% of individual medical premiums and help offset the cost of family coverage.

  • 401K with Employer Match

Eligible after 90 days, with company matching to help you invest in your future.

  • Disability Coverage

Both short- and long-term disability insurance provided at no cost to our employees.

  • Flexible PTO

Take time off when you need it, no accruing time necessary.

  • Field-Based Employee Benefits

For eligible field-based roles that require travel, Divcon covers all business travel expenses and provides a per diem, phone allowance, tools, and PPE at no cost. Eligible employees also receive paid training and additional reimbursable business expenses.

Divcon does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies. Agencies must have a signed agreement in place prior to submitting any candidate. Unsolicited resumes will be considered the property of Divcon, and no fees will be paid.

raw.description:
Shiji is a global technology company dedicated to providing innovative solutions for the hospitality industry, ensuring seamless operations for hoteliers day and night.

Built on the Shiji Platform—the only truly global hotel technology platform—Shiji’s cloud-based portfolio includes Property Management System, Point-of-Sale, guest engagement, distribution, payments, and data intelligence solutions for over 91,000 hotels worldwide, including the largest chains.

With more than 5,000 employees across the world, Shiji is a trusted partner for the world’s leading hoteliers, delivering technology that works as continuously as the industry itself. That’s why the best hotels run on Shiji—day and night. While its primary focus is on hospitality, Shiji also serves select customers in food service, retail, and entertainment in certain regions.

The best hotels run on Shiji—day and night.

Your Role

The Sales Operations Manager plays a critical role in enabling the performance, productivity, and operational excellence of Shiji's sales organization across the Americas. Serving as a strategic operational partner, this role equips sales leaders and teams with the systems, processes, reporting, forecasting, and actionable insights needed to execute consistently execution and make informed business decisions.

Working closely with Sales leadership, Marketing, and cross-functional teams, the Sales Operations Manager owns and continuously improves CRM administration, pipeline management, forecasting, reporting, dashboards, and sales performance analysis. This role identifies opportunities to streamline processes, strengthen pipeline visibility and operational discipline, and leverage automation and AI enabled workflows so sales teams can spend more time on customer-facing activities.

What You Will Do

  • Own and continuously improve sales operations processes across the Americas, supporting sales leadership and teams throughout the region.
  • Strengthen sales accountability and execution by monitoring performance against key metrics, reinforcing operational standards, and identifying opportunities for improvement.
  • Own sales forecasting processes and reporting cadences, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and visibility into pipeline health and expected revenue performance.
  • Analyze sales and business data to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and actionable insights that support informed decision-making.
  • Develop, maintain, and optimize dashboards, reports, and visualizations that provide sales leadership with meaningful visibility into pipeline, sales activity, forecast performance, territory performance, and other key business metrics.
  • Own CRM administration and data quality standards, driving user adoption, pipeline hygiene, accurate opportunity management, and consistent use of established sales processes across the organization.
  • Partner with Sales leadership to improve sales productivity and effectiveness through territory planning, account assignment, pipeline optimization, capacity analysis, and continuous process improvement.
  • Develop, document, and continuously refine sales processes, policies, and operational standards, while supporting their adoption across the organization.
  • Identify and implement opportunities to automate and streamline sales workflows using AI and other technologies, including pipeline analysis, information gathering, email and communication workflows, reporting, and administrative
  • processes.
  • Support and coach sales teams on CRM usage, pipeline management, forecasting discipline, sales tools, and operational best practices.
  • Manage the adoption, utilization, and effectiveness of sales technology tools, ensuring they deliver measurable improvements in sales productivity and performance.
  • Partner with Customer Success, Delivery, Support, Marketing, and other key stakeholders to identify and remove operational obstacles affecting sales productivity, efficiency, and customer outcomes.

What We Are Looking For (Required Qualifications)

  • Minimum four (4) years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations or a related function within a high-growth B2B software, SaaS, hospitality technology, or similarly complex business environment.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with sales forecasting, pipeline management, sales reporting, and performance analysis.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data, identify meaningful trends, and translate findings into clear business insights and actionable recommendations.
  • Advanced knowledge of CRM systems, including hands-on experience supporting CRM administration, data governance, pipeline management, reporting, and user adoption.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively and present information clearly to stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
  • Strong independent problem-solving and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to identify operational challenges, evaluate potential solutions, and practical improvements.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, coordinate cross-functional initiatives, and deliver results within agreed-upon timelines.

Nice to Have (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience in the hospitality technology industry.
  • Experience using Zoho CRM.
  • Prior direct sales experience as an individual contributor.
  • Experience with Business Intelligence (BI) platforms, including creating reports, dashboards, and data visualizations.
  • Hands-on experience designing, building, or optimizing AI-enabled or automated workflows to improve sales productivity, pipeline analysis, reporting, or other sales operations processes.

raw.description:
Highlights:

Location: Remote (CET hours preferred)

Language: Russian-speaking team

About Fundraise Up

We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.

A Truly Global Product

We operate in the enterprise segment, serving nonprofit organizations across North America, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Europe.

We’re building a large and complex product ecosystem that serves nonprofits, donors, and partners around the world. The platform includes a modern checkout experience and customizable widgets (each a standalone SPA), donor, organization, and partner portals, admin tools, and several internal apps.

Our backend is powered by Node.js (Koa, NestJS) and MongoDB. The frontend stack includes Webpack, Vue.js, and React, with nearly all code written in TypeScript. For high-throughput messaging and background processing, we use Kafka (for millions of events) and Bull (Redis). Analytics data is stored in ClickHouse, and we use Elasticsearch for search.

The Team

We are a distributed team of 160+ product professionals, including 80+ engineers. Our team members are mainly based across Spain, Poland, Portugal, Georgia, Armenia, Serbia, Turkey, and Cyprus. Many of our developers bring 5 - 10+ years of experience, and we foster a culture of deep technical curiosity and knowledge sharing.

Despite our scale, we operate like a focused team - where every task matters and every voice is heard. We value thoughtful collaboration, strong engineering practices, and a product mindset. You’ll be joining a team where quality, mentorship, and mutual respect come first.

About the Role

As a Senior Fullstack Developer, you will be a key contributor to our core product, building and scaling features that are central to the donation experience for millions of users. You'll leverage your expertise in Node.js, React, and TypeScript to develop complex components—from dynamic donation widgets to data-driven admin dashboards—with a relentless focus on code quality, scalability, and user experience.

This is an ideal opportunity if you love solving real-world problems at scale and want to grow within a mission-driven, high-impact engineering culture.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain resilient frontend and backend features using React and Node.js.
  • Develop our core products, including donation checkouts, embeddable widgets, and donor/partner portals.
  • Architect and develop system components that scale across millions of monthly transactions.
  • Write clean, well-documented, and thoroughly testable code.
  • Drive architecture and technical design discussions to find elegant solutions to complex problems.
  • Mentor peers by conducting thoughtful code reviews and providing constructive feedback.
  • Partner with product managers and designers to clarify requirements and shape the roadmap.
  • Proactively identify and resolve bugs, performance bottlenecks, and optimization opportunities.
  • At Fundraise Up, AI is a default tool, not an experimental one. We expect every team member to actively use AI in their day-to-day work, identify where AI can change the shape of problems in their function, and grow their fluency as the tools evolve. You should already be using AI meaningfully in your work and understand where it adds value and how it can improve the way you operate.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of professional fullstack development experience.
  • Deep understanding of modern JavaScript (event loop, closures, promises, prototypes).
  • Expert-level proficiency with React and its ecosystem (familiarity with Vue is a plus).
  • Strong backend expertise with Node.js (experience with Koa or NestJS is highly preferred).
  • Experience with Webpack configuration, performance optimization, and profiling.
  • A keen eye for detail and a high sense of ownership and accountability for your work.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with MongoDB, ClickHouse, or Elasticsearch.
  • Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, or cloud infrastructure.
  • Contributions to open-source projects or a strong personal portfolio.

Bonus points

  • Curiosity and a hypothesis-driven mindset.
  • Ability to communicate complex analytical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership.
  • Comfort working in fast-paced, data-rich environments.

Why work with us

  • A strong, collaborative product team that owns what it builds.
  • Clear product vision and access to real customer feedback from global nonprofit leaders.
  • Flat structure: no politics, just great work with great people.
  • Transparent company culture-we share how we’re growing, where revenue comes from, and what’s next.
  • Long-term focus: we offer equity options and value sustained, meaningful contribution.

Compensation

  • The compensation range for this role is: $3,800 - $5,100 gross per month.
  • Final compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, and alignment with the role's requirements.

Benefits

  • 31 days off.
  • 100% paid telemedicine plan.
  • Home Office Setup Assistance: the company offers assistance with purchasing furniture (office chair, office desk, monitor) and other items to create a comfortable workspace.
  • English learning courses.
  • Relevant professional education.
  • Gym or swimming pool.
  • Co-working.
  • Remote working.

**Please note: All official correspondence from Fundraise Up will exclusively originate from the @fundraiseup.com domain. Exercise caution and ensure the authenticity of emails claiming to be from our company.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law in the countries where we operate.

raw.description:
At Caris, we understand that cancer is an ugly word—a word no one wants to hear, but one that connects us all. That’s why we’re not just transforming cancer care—we’re changing lives.

We introduced precision medicine to the world and built an industry around the idea that every patient deserves answers as unique as their DNA. Backed by cutting-edge molecular science and AI, we ask ourselves every day:“What would I do if this patient were my mom?”That question drives everything we do.

But our mission doesn’t stop with cancer. We're pushing the frontiers of medicine and leading a revolution in healthcare—driven by innovation, compassion, and purpose.

Join us in our mission to improve the human condition across multiple diseases. If you're passionate about meaningful work and want to be part of something bigger than yourself, Caris is where your impact begins.

Position Summary
The Senior Strategic Solutions Manager is responsible for leading the business solution and contracting strategy in assigned area. This includes effectively managing the account priorities for proactive business solutions with their Operational Solutions Manager and successfully achieving the business solutions and contracting strategy with complex and system accounts. This is a cross-functional role that requires the collaboration of several Caris departments, and the Senior Strategic Solutions Manager must run point in their area to provide high-level solutions and meaningful outcomes to their customers.

Job Responsibilities

  • Build partnerships with decision makers within laboratory and hospital administration to achieve meaningful business solution outcomes.
  • Effectively develop and present business and contracting strategies and proposals aligned to organizational and customer needs with consideration to ROI and ASP.
  • Lead and facilitate meetings in-person or virtually.
  • Negotiate complex contract terms and pricing to deliver solutions for Caris’ portfolio of offerings with a wide range of customers including Hospital Systems, GPOs and IDN’s.
  • Ensure compliance with internal governance requirements and statutory pricing regulations.
  • Effectively manage competing contract priorities from initiation through post-execution to include establishing optimized contract workflows and term adherence.
  • Maintain communication with legal team on contracting redlines and terms.
  • Strategically collaborate with commercial team on complex, high-impact accounts to include Strategic Accounts and Regional Business Directors.
  • Responsible for driving the LEADS/LAGS to include leading the priorities and activities of all business solutions in the Area.
  • Identify and develop training and ongoing development opportunities for team and new hires.
  • Ensure that all services delivered in assigned area are high quality and delivered in an excellent customer-focused manner.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert in various hospital administration and laboratory-related areas of focus.
  • Strong attention to detail & organizational skills, with emphasis on document control, repository maintenance and tracking deliverables.
  • Monitor and analyze account metrics to address or delegate any gaps or areas for improvement.
  • Identify and execute on opportunities by initiating new and innovative ideas to improve/expand business solutions for both internal and external partners.
  • Reliably meet and exceed established team goals and initiatives within timelines set by management.
  • Maintain open communication with direct leadership and other internal leaders to review progress, strategic challenges, and opportunities across assigned area.
  • Maintain and grow “core” knowledge of Caris offerings, competitive landscape, and hospital/laboratory administration issues.
  • Maintain all assigned company assets including laptop computer, iPhone, etc.
  • Submit all necessary paperwork, business plans, reports and expenses as required, accurately and in a timely manner.
  • Perform ancillary projects or other related duties as assigned.
  • Must maintain HIPAA and other compliance guidelines at all times.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, management, life sciences, or related field and/or a minimum 5 years of equivalent experience.
  • Demonstrated experience in effectively implementing business-solution related initiatives, managing challenging situations and problem solving.
  • Must be able to utilize critical thinking skills.
  • Demonstrated experience in managing timelines, projects, documentation and tracking progress, and resolving conflicts.
  • Ability to efficiently multi-task and manage multiple projects and work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven, matrixed environment.
  • Possesses strong communication skills (both written and verbal).
  • Must possess skills in building and maintaining strong, trusting relationships with clients, internal sales teams and other cross-functional departments.
  • Proficient in CRM systems (i.e., Salesforce), reporting tools (i.e., Tableau), and Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Excellent team lead and people management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Management, or related field.
  • Prior leadership or mentoring experience.
  • Familiarity with hospital systems and pathology networks.
  • Established relationships within the hospital, laboratory, and pathology space.
  • Prior contracting negotiation experience.

Physical Demands

  • Must possess ability to sit and/or stand for long periods of time.
  • Employee may be required to lift routine office supplies and use standard office equipment.

Required Training

  • New Hire Training
  • Compliance & Policy Training
  • HIPAA

​

Conditions of Employment: Individual must successfully complete pre-employment process, which includes criminal background check, drug screening, credit check( applicable for certain positions) and reference verification.

Bridgeway is seeking a relationship-driven and results-oriented Customer Success Manager (CSM) to serve as a trusted advisor to our customers and a key driver of long-term revenue growth. As a critical member of the Customer Success organization, the CSM will own the full post-sale customer relationship — translating business goals into measurable success plans, accelerating product adoption, and executing strategies that deliver tangible, lasting value. This role operates at the intersection of customer outcomes and business performance, with direct accountability for customer satisfaction, retention, and revenue expansion. The CSM will partner closely with Sales, Professional Services, Support and Product to ensure engagements are properly scoped, and up-sell opportunities are identified and advanced.

This is a remote position with travel up to 10%. Preference is given to East Coast candidates.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own customer lifecycle from onboarding through expansion
  • Identify, shape, and close expansion opportunities in partnership with Sales
  • Proactively mitigate churn risk through data-driven engagement strategies
  • Maintain accurate forecasting for growth opportunities
  • Partner with customers to define clear, measurable success metrics aligned to their business goals
  • Develop and execute customer success plans tied to revenue growth or operational efficiency and aligned to the defined customer segmentation and engagement strategy
  • Drive product adoption as the foundation for value realization
  • Track and communicate progress against outcomes through QBRs and ongoing engagement
  • Leverage customer health, usage data, and engagement signals to identify risks and opportunities, prioritize actions and outreach, and inform account strategy
  • Act as the internal orchestrator across Sales, Product, Engineering, Professional Services, and Support, including partnering with the assigned AE within a pod structure to align on account strategy and execution
  • Provide voice of the customer insights to influence product roadmap and GTM strategy
  • Engage and influence senior stakeholders on business outcomes and strategy
  • Lead QBRs focused on value realization and commercial outcomes (not just activity reporting)
  • Navigate complex conversations, including billing and invoicing disputes, arrears, price increases, risk mitigation, and customer escalations requiring cross-functional coordination
  • Create, track, and report on customer-facing projects and initiatives across assigned accounts, ensuring scope, milestones, owners, and timelines are clearly documented and communicated in partnership with Professional Serivces
  • Follow and improve standardized processes (including execution against tier-based engagement models, customer onboarding and offboarding, QBRs, and reset plans for at-risk accounts)
  • Represent Bridgeway in customer-facing forums and community engagements (e.g., user groups, advisory boards, UGC conference) to deepen relationships and capture structured feedback
  • Maintain CRM hygiene and forecasting accuracy in HubSpot, expansion, terminations and customer health data are current and actionable
  • Leverage generative AI tools such as Claude and Copilot to streamline workflows, enhance productivity, improve solution quality, and accelerate delivery of business outcomes.

Qualifications

  • 4+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or a related client-facing role within a B2B SaaS or technology environment
  • Strong executive communication and stakeholder influence skills, with the ability to align senior decision-makers around business strategy
  • Proficiency with generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT) to enhance productivity and quality of customer-facing work
  • Proficiency with CRM systems (e.g., Hubspot, Salesforce), with a track record of accurate pipeline management and system documentation
  • Proficiency with CS platforms (e.g., Gainsight, Totango, ChurnZero) is a plus
  • Experience in benefits administration, HR technology, or a related regulated industry is a plus
  • Experience using generative AI tools such as Claude and Copilot to improve productivity and deliver high-quality outcomes
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Communications, or a related field.

Job Description:

Title:M&A Paralegal

Work Mode:Fully remote for candidates located in Florida, Georgia, or South Carolina. Monthly travel required to Longwood, FL| Requirements:2–5 years of paralegal experience

Please note: If this position is posted as either fully remote and/or hybrid, in accordance with company policy, individuals residing within a 50-mile radius of a branch location may be required to work onsite in a hybrid capacity as there may be occasions when on-site presence is necessary to meet specific business needs. Additionally, our remote work policy includes having a dedicated, distraction-free workspace. Remote work is not a substitute for childcare, elder care, or other personal responsibilities during working hours. To view our branch locations, please visit: ioausa.com/locations

About the Role: The M&A Paralegal is responsible for providing legal, transactional, and compliance support to the Legal Department and M&A team, with a primary focus on acquisition activity, entity management, and insurance agency operations. This role supports transaction documentation, contract administration, corporate governance, licensing activities, regulatory compliance, and post-close integration efforts. Working closely with Legal, Compliance, HR, Risk Management, Finance, Operations, outside counsel, and acquisition partners, the M&A Paralegal helps ensure transactions and legal processes are executed accurately, efficiently, and in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Transaction Support:Support M&A transactions by maintaining deal checklists, coordinating execution packages, managing closing activities, and tracking post-closing deliverables.

  • Contract & Document Management:Draft, review, route, track, and maintain legal agreements, contract repositories, templates, version controls, and audit-ready documentation.

  • Corporate Governance:Prepare and maintain entity registrations, annual reports, corporate resolutions, governance records, and related filings for existing and acquired entities.

  • Licensing & Regulatory Support:Assist with agency licensing, renewals, appointments, entity changes, regulatory filings, and compliance-related activities.

  • Legal Research & Regulatory Monitoring:Research insurance regulations, licensing requirements, and industry compliance standards while monitoring regulatory changes and communicating key updates.

  • Claims & Litigation Coordination:Support E&O claims, litigation holds, subpoenas, carrier inquiries, discovery requests, and regulatory notices while tracking deadlines and responses.

  • Compliance & Audit Support:Assist with internal audits, compliance reviews, risk management initiatives, and supporting documentation requirements.

  • Reporting & Communication:Prepare reports, summaries, correspondence, briefings, and presentation materials for Legal, M&A, and executive leadership teams.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration:Partner with Legal, Compliance, Finance, HR, Operations, outside counsel, and acquisition stakeholders to support transactions and business objectives.

  • Project Coordination:Support legal and M&A projects through meeting coordination, agenda preparation, document distribution, and action-item tracking.

  • Process Improvement:Identify and implement improvements tolegal,compliance, contract management, and transaction support processes.

  • Technical & Professional Development:Maintain current knowledge of legal procedures, insurance regulations, corporate governance practices, and M&A best practices.

  • Champion IOA Values:Demonstrate integrity, leadership, accountability, and professionalism in all interactions.

Ideal CandidateQualifications:

  • Associate’s or Bachelor’sdegree, equivalent experience, or Paralegal certification preferred

  • 2–5 years of paralegal experience within insurance, financial services, corporate law, or another regulated industry

  • Experience supporting M&A transactions, due diligence, corporate governance, compliance, or post-close integration activities preferred

  • Strong understanding of legal terminology, contract administration, regulatory compliance, and insurance licensing processes

  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities

  • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across departments and with external partners

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and contract or document management systems

  • Demonstrated discretion, integrity, and professionalism when handling confidential and privileged information

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salaries and bonus potential

  • Company-paid health insurance

  • Paid holidays, vacations, and sick time

  • 401K with employer match

  • Professional growth and career progression opportunities

  • Respectful culture and work/family life balance

  • Community service commitment

  • Supportive teammates and a rewarding work environment

What to Expect(Application Process):

  • 30-Minute Phone Screen, Online Assessments, and Interview(s).

Salary Range

The expected pay range for this position is $135,000 to $150,000 per year, depending on experience, relevant skills, and geographic location.

Insurance Office of America is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Senior Solutions Architect, Higher Education and Research, Multimodal and Physic
description: NVIDIA has been redefining computer graphics and accelerated computing for three decades.

raw.title: Senior Solutions Architect, Higher Education and Research, Multimodal and Physic
raw.excerpt: NVIDIA has been redefining computer graphics and accelerated computing for three decades.
raw.description:
NVIDIA has been redefining computer graphics and accelerated computing for three decades. Today, we are tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. Doing what has never been done before takes vision, innovation, and exceptional talent. As an NVIDIAN, you will be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is encouraged to do their best work and make a lasting impact on the world.

We are looking for a Solutions Architect in the Greater London area to work with academia and research partners. Solutions Architects are the primary technical contacts for our customers and engage deeply with researchers and application developers to drive the adoption of NVIDIA technology. We seek an individual who combines an intricate understanding of Multimodal AI and Physical AI with expertise in accelerated computing and architecture.

What you will be doing:

  • Partner directly with leading research labs, researchers, and university faculty as a trusted technical advisor: develop a keen understanding of their scientific goals and drive joint research projects at supercomputing scale.

  • Identify and accelerate high-impact workloads by integrating NVIDIA's frameworks, libraries, and core software stack into research projects, and help researchers amplify their impact through publications, conference presentations, and technical content.

  • Advocate for accelerated computing, robotics, Multimodal AI and Physical AI, and deliver hands-on trainings, workshops, lectures and demonstrations across NVIDIA's platforms, and mentor power users to become NVIDIA champions.

  • Track emerging research trends and turn gaps between researcher needs and NVIDIA's offerings into prototypical solutions and direct feedback to NVIDIA Engineering.

  • Maintain deep expertise in your domain while staying versatile across NVIDIA's full platform: GPUs, CPUs, networking, and software

What we need to see:

  • A graduate degree from a leading university in a STEM related discipline.

  • 5+ years in the multimodal and world model lifecycle on multi-node GPU systems: video and image data curation at scale, pre-training and post-training, evaluation, and efficient inference.

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to build relationships with academic and research stakeholders, and to communicate complex ideas clearly to both expert and non-expert audiences.

  • Action oriented, analytical, self-motivated, and a passionate learner, with excellent organization skills to work in a heavily multi-tasked environment.

  • Fluent in English, both oral and written, and comfortable working in Python.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • A PhD from a leading university in a STEM related discipline, with 3+ years of research in the domain.

  • A track record of thought leadership: high-impact publications, talks at academic conferences and workshops, as well as good understanding of scientific policy engagement, grant processes, or national/European research program structures.

  • Experience with NVIDIA's stack for visual and multimodal AI, built on CUDA and CUDA-X, including Cosmos world foundation models, NeMo Framework and Megatron for multimodal model training, multimodal Nemotron methodology, Isaac robotics platform, NuRec for neural reconstruction, TensorRT and NIM for deployment, and domain frameworks such as MONAI for medical imaging.

As a Solutions Architect, there is travel involved, as often the best way to figure things out is a face-toface meeting, but the job is not life on the road. We make heavy use of conferencing tools, and you are empowered to figure out how to get the job done and do what it takes to make our customers successful.

raw.description:
About Us

At Open Farm we are transforming the way people feed their pets, with a focus on producing premium, healthy food and treats, all ethically sourced from farm-to-bowl. Headquartered in Toronto and with team members across the US, Open Farm is one of the fastest growing CPG companies in North America. We believe that the best foods are made with consciously sourced, top-quality ingredients from farmers and fisheries who believe in doing good for all animals and the environment.

Role Description:

Reporting to the Regional Director of Sales, a Territory Sales Manager plays a key role in driving sales performance, accelerating market expansion, and building brand presence in both existing and new territories. We're seeking an exceptional candidate responsible for executing strategies that grow Open Farm's retail footprint in Northern California. The focus will be to strengthen relationships with key accounts and retailers, and ensure our products are well represented and top-of-mind for consumers in the retail space.

A Territory Sales Manager directly contributes to the company's overall growth by identifying new business opportunities, optimizing sales channels, and executing sales and retail initiatives that enhance visibility and market share across the region. A Territory Sales Manager also act as a brand ambassador - inspiring retailers, distributors, and cusotmers alike to champion Open Farm's mission and products.

Responsibilities:

Sales Optimization

  • Drive Territory Growth: Consistently meet and exceed sales targets by implementing strategic initiatives that fuel revenue growth and strengthen Open Farm’s market position.
  • Strategic Forecasting & Planning: Develop forward-looking territory plans grounded in data, insights, and market trends to ensure alignment with company goals and long-term growth strategies.
  • Effective Budget Stewardship: Manage budgets related to travel, promotions, and customer engagement with a focus on maximizing ROI and supporting impactful growth initiatives.

Customer Focus

  • Build Meaningful Partnerships: Cultivate deep, trust-based relationships with retailers, distributors, and key partners, becoming their go-to resource for driving mutual success.
  • Customer Relationship Management: Engage consistently with accounts through store visits and ongoing communication to strengthen loyalty and advocacy for the Open Farm brand.
  • Empower Through Education: Deliver compelling product and brand training sessions that inspire confidence, deepen product knowledge, and equip partners to effectively champion Open Farm in-store.
  • Solutions-Oriented Mindset: Address challenges with empathy, urgency, and creativity, collaborating cross-functionally to deliver solutions that enhance customer satisfaction and business outcomes.

Business Development & Operations

  • Expand Our Footprint: Identify and capture new business opportunities through proactive prospecting, relationship building, and strategic networking.
  • Champion the Brand: Collaborate with marketing and retail partners to execute engaging promotional programs, events, and in-store activations that bring the Open Farm story to life.
  • Insights-Driven Performance: Monitor market trends, competitive activity, and customer feedback to uncover opportunities and provide actionable insights that inform strategic decisions.
  • Integrity in Action: Uphold Open Farm’s values by ensuring all sales and marketing activities reflect our commitment to ethics, transparency, and excellence.

Required Experience and Skills

  • 3+ years of experience in sales or territory management; experience in the pet industry is an asset.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive growth, exceed targets, and expand market presence.
  • A track record of developing and executing effective sales strategies that deliver measurable results and strengthen brand impact.
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills that foster trust, collaboration, and long-term partnerships with customers and colleagues alike.
  • A self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and is motivated to make a meaningful impact every day.
  • Outstanding time management and prioritization skills, with the ability to balance multiple initiatives and deliver consistently high-quality results.
  • A team player who values connection, feedback, and shared success while taking ownership of individual goals.
  • A proactive, positive attitude paired with a genuine passion for pets, the planet, and Open Farm’s purpose-driven mission.
  • Competence in Excel, PowerPoint, and sales reporting systems to support data-driven territory management.

Territory and Travel Requirements

This role demands a high level of flexibility, mobility, and commitment to in-person relationship building. The Territory Sales Manager works primarily in the field, requiring regular travel and a proactive, hands-on approach to driving results through in-person retailer communication and store visits.

The Territory Sales Manager (TSM) position requires flexible work arrangements, including occasional evenings and weekends, with a minimum of 20 in-person retail store visits per week and up to 60% overnight travel within the assigned territory. The territory includes Northern California.

A TSM is required to hold a valid driver’s license; reliable transportation and the ability to travel extensively are essential for success in this role.

A TSM is typically a remote position, and employees must reside within the assigned territory to effectively manage regional relationships and opportunities. Territories may be reassigned at the discretion of the Company.

Our Values

We Raise the Bar | We Open the Barn Doors | We Graze Lightly | We Are Customer Obsessed | We Are One Team  | Win-Win Partnerships

To learn more about Open Farm, follow us on Instagramand LinkedIn.

La technicienne ou le technicien de service est responsable d'installer, de configurer, d'entretenir, de diagnostiquer et de réparer les systèmes et équipements (matériel et logiciel) des clients. Ce travail peut s'effectuer sur site ou hors site et pourrait nécessiter de la coordination ou de la coopération avec d'autres équipes de soutien ou tiers. Le travail est typiquement réalisé dans la région assignée, mais pourrait être mené partout sur le territoire canadien. De plus, des déplacements, du travail après les heures normales de bureau et du travail la fin de semaine sont requis.

Responsabilités spécifiques

  • Agir à titre de représentant(e) du service auprès de clients attitrés.

  • Effectuer l’entretien préventif.

Ces tâches peuvent devoir être effectuées après les heures normales de travail, selon un calendrier de garde rotatif.

raw.description:
As a senior engineer, you'll work across a diverse software portfolio—improving UIs, adding optimization workflows, fixing C++ bugs, and building MCP servers for LLM integration—rather than being tied to one product.

You will work across our software portfolio rather than on a single product. On any given week that might mean improving the UI of a simulation control tool, adding a new optimisation workflow, fixing a bug in a C++ codebase, or building an MCP server that exposes one of our tools to an LLM agent.

UI quality and AI-friendliness are both priorities here, and they reinforce each other. A well-designed tool with clear inputs, predictable behaviour, and informative feedback is easier for a scientist to use and easier for an LLM to drive reliably. You will think about both audiences. Part of your work will be making our existing tools usable by AI agents, designing tool interfaces that behave well when an LLM is at the controls, and building agent pipelines that integrate with our simulation workflows.

We also have new projects to start from scratch. As you build familiarity with the domain and demonstrate ownership, there is genuine opportunity to lead one of those projects end-to-end.

No prior background in simulation or optimisation is expected. The domain is learnable and we will support that process. What matters is that you are genuinely curious, pick things up quickly, and enjoy building tools that serious technical users depend on.

C++ Programming Language; BS in Computer Science or applicable experience; must be fluent in English.

Minimum 5-8 years experience in this type of role and preferably in the semi-conductor industry.

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location, and the range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location, role-related knowledge and skills, depth of experience, relevant education or training, and additional role-related considerations.

Depending on the position offered, equity, bonuses, commission, or other forms of compensation may also be provided as part of a total compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and other benefits.

WE ARE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

At Silvaco, we do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at 408.567.1000.

About Silvaco, Inc.

For over four decades, Silvaco, based in Silicon Valley, California and with global locations around the world has solved semiconductor design challenges by offering affordable and competitive TCAD (Technology Computer Aided Design) software, EDA (Electronic Design Automation) software, proven design IP (intellectual property), and world class support to engineers and researchers across the globe. Silvaco solutions span from atoms to systems: starting with simulation of material behavior impacting semiconductor devices, to design and analysis of transistor circuits, and lastly providing IP blocks for systems-on-chip (SoC) designs. Our solutions are deployed in production flows across broad industry segments such as leading display companies, automotive OEM suppliers, and top Memory, 5G, and IoT (internet of things) providers.

The Role

As a Staff Product Designer, you'll lead the design for how primary care clinicians work. You’ll develop a deep understanding of their workflows to inspire an AI-native experience while keeping the team grounded in day-to-day clinical practice.

This role is for someone who creates and champions compelling UX strategy and experience visions while guiding work across multiple squads. You'll shape interaction patterns and contribute to visual language development — all while modeling the craft, curiosity, and collaborative ways of working that raise the bar for designers around you.

Clinicians have repeatedly awarded Elation "Best in KLAS" in our category, a recognition that reflects our clinician-first approach to everything we build. Reporting up through our Chief Product Officer, you'll work autonomously within your team while remaining connected to a centralized design group that is deeply collaborative and curious. You'll also find enthusiastic partners in our on-staff physicians, our users, and teams across the organization.

If you want to do complex, meaningful work at the place where design and healthcare intersect, we'd love to hear from you!

What You'll Do (Role and Responsibilities)

  • Deeply understand our users — their problems, workflows, and jobs-to-be-done — to ensure we are always solving for the right thing.
  • Own and lead the design process from discovery to delivery, making key decisions on solution direction and details.
  • Drive the strategic direction of your domain in partnership with Product and Engineering, forecasting the impact of your solutions on users.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to deliver a clear, consistent, and high-quality user experience.
  • As an AI-native design leader, you will balance cutting-edge technology with patient safety and accuracy across user-facing and backend experiences.
  • Define and own the user satisfaction and usability metrics for your solutions, ensuring the team is aligned on how to measure success.
  • Be a leader on the design team by mentoring other designers, leading design critiques, and driving initiatives that improve our culture, tools, and processes.

What We're Looking For (Experience and Skills)

  • 8+ years of experience designing and shipping complex, web-based products in a cross-functional team.
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating your ability to navigate ambiguous problem spaces, from research and strategy through to polished, human-centered user experiences. Your portfolio should showcase your strengths in UX, UI, and visual design.
  • Proven experience in leading and executing a variety of user research methods.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a track record of building strong partnerships with Product and Engineering.

The Director, Enterprise Sales will serve as a key member of the Professional leadership team, responsible for shaping and executing the commercial strategy for the Enterprise segment across North America. Reporting directly to the Executive Vice President and Segment Leader, U.S. Professional Market, Wolters Kluwer Tax & Accounting North America, this executive will serve as the top commercial leader for the Enterprise business – driving growth for the segment.

The Director will lead a team of three high level sellers who serve Tax & Accounting’s largest customers. Operating within a matrixed structure, this leader will collaborate closely with the three North American General Managers, as well as partners across Revenue Operations, Enablement, Marketing, and Product, to align strategy, drive execution, and achieve scalable, predictable growth.

This role represents a pivotal opportunity to lead during a period of accelerated transformation, shifting towards enterprise, value-based customer engagement. The Director will partner with the Vice President, Professional Segment Sales to for modernize the go-to-market strategy, drive adoption of AI-enabled and data-driven solutions, and elevate sales performance standards. They will own end-to-end commercial outcomes including bookings, ARR growth, pipeline health, and forecast accuracy, ensuring alignment with broader divisional and enterprise objectives.

This is a highly visible, field-oriented role requiring a forward-thinking, results-driven leader who combines strategic vision with operational discipline. The Director must be able to translate insight into action, lead through influence in a complex organization, and sustain a culture of accountability and high performance.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

▪Develop and execute the commercial strategy for the Enterprise segment, aligning with divisional and enterprise growth objectives across retention and new business acquisition.
▪Lead a team of high level sellers who serve our largest customers, fostering collaboration, accountability, and performance excellence.
▪Drive transformation toward an enterprise, value-based, consultative model focused on long-term client partnerships and holistic solutions.

▪Establish a disciplined operating cadence, implementing robust forecasting, pipeline inspection, and performance management processes to improve predictability and ensure consistent achievement of revenue targets.
▪Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to strengthen go-to-market execution, refine segmentation models, and enhance commercial enablement and alignment.
▪Champion talent development, building a high-performing, engaged sales culture focused on professional growth, skill-building, and succession readiness.
▪Partner with customer unit General Managers and divisional leadership to ensure cohesive execution across business lines and alignment on customer strategy, pricing, and territory design.
▪Serve as a strategic voice of the customer, relaying market insights, emerging needs, and competitive intelligence to influence product roadmaps, innovation priorities, and service enhancements.
▪Act as a field-oriented leader, maintaining regular engagement with clients and teams to reinforce customer intimacy, coach in-market execution, and ensure delivery of value-based outcomes.
▪Collaborate with Revenue Operations and Enablement to enhance sales readiness, operational efficiency, and the integration of data, analytics, and AI-driven insights into the commercial process.
▪Foster a culture of collaboration and accountability, ensuring sales goals, compensation plans, and performance metrics are tightly aligned with strategic objectives.
▪Lead with transparency and integrity, serving as a visible ambassador of Wolters Kluwer’s values, leadership standards, and commitment to innovation, inclusion, and customer success.

 

Wolters Kluwer seeks a commercially minded sales executive who can accelerate growth and lead the transformation of its Enterprise segment into a value-based, enterprise-oriented sales organization. The Director, Enterprise Sales will bring a balance of strategic vision, operational discipline, and leadership presence to drive predictable, scalable revenue outcomes.

The ideal candidate will combine deep SaaS sales leadership experience with a proven ability to lead large, hybrid sales organizations through transformation. This executive will be known for building accountability, elevating performance standards, and driving collaboration across a complex, matrixed enterprise.

Experience & Expertise

▪15+ years of progressive sales leadership experience in enterprise software or SaaS environments, managing both field and inside sales teams across multiple segments.
▪Demonstrated success driving revenue growth through value-based, solution selling and SaaS or subscription-based models.
▪Experience leading commercial organizations through sales modernization, including forecasting rigor, pipeline inspection, and metrics-driven process improvement.
▪Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to align go-to-market plans and improve execution.
▪Expertise in Salesforce (SFDC) and data-driven sales management practices to increase forecast accuracy, pipeline quality, and sales velocity.
▪Track record of building and scaling high-performing teams, fostering accountability, coaching talent, and developing next-generation leaders.
▪Experience operating within a matrixed, global organization, balancing near-term tactical delivery with long-term strategic growth.
▪Strong commercial acumen and understanding of key financial levers including ARR growth, CAC efficiency, and margin optimization.

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

$137,900.00 - $246,350.00 USD

Compensation range listed is based on primary location of the position. Actual base salary offer is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skills, experience and actual hiring location. Your recruiter can share more information about the specific offer for the job location during the hiring process.

Job Summary

The Management Analyst will support the Veterans Health Administration (VHA) Integrated Veteran Care (IVC) Veteran Family Member Programs (VFMP) Modernization Portfolio by providing analytical, operational, organizational, and process improvement support for modernization and automation initiatives across VFMP operations.

This role supports enterprise transformation efforts related to healthcare claims processing, eligibility modernization, appeals modernization, Electronic Data Interchange (EDI), workflow automation, inventory reduction, business process optimization, and organizational efficiency initiatives. The Management Analyst will analyze current operational processes, identify improvement opportunities, develop recommendations, support modernization implementation activities, and assist with organizational reporting and performance monitoring.

The Management Analyst will work collaboratively with Government leadership, project teams, operational stakeholders, technical personnel, and contractor staff to support strategic modernization initiatives and ensure alignment with VFMP operational priorities, governance standards, and performance objectives.

This role requires strong analytical capabilities, organizational assessment skills, communication abilities, and experience supporting operational improvement and modernization efforts within a healthcare or government environment.

Primary Responsibilities

Operational & Organizational Analysis

  • Conduct operational analyses of VFMP business processes, workflows, organizational structures, and modernization initiatives.
  • Evaluate operational effectiveness, workflow efficiency, inventory management, and business performance.
  • Assess current-state and future-state operational environments to identify modernization opportunities.
  • Perform gap analyses and develop recommendations supporting process improvement and operational efficiencies.
  • Analyze workflow bottlenecks, staffing impacts, operational risks, and performance metrics.
  • Assist leadership with identifying opportunities to improve service delivery, processing timeliness, and operational outcomes.

Business Process Improvement

  • Support business process redesign and workflow optimization initiatives across VFMP operations.
  • Analyze operational procedures supporting:
    • Claims processing
    • Eligibility determination
    • Appeals processing
    • Intake and document processing
    • Benefits coordination
    • Care coordination
    • Pharmacy support
    • Customer service operations
  • Support development of modernization recommendations that improve operational efficiency and reduce manual workload.
  • Assist with implementation and operational integration of modernization initiatives.

Research, Reporting & Documentation

  • Collect, analyze, and interpret operational and program data.
  • Develop reports, findings, summaries, dashboards, and recommendations for leadership review.
  • Prepare executive summaries, briefing materials, and analytical reports supporting modernization initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain:
    • Process flow diagrams
    • Operational assessments
    • Gap analysis reports
    • Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
    • Business process documentation
    • Workflow documentation
    • Meeting minutes and action item trackers
  • Ensure documentation is accurate, organized, and aligned with VFMP modernization standards.

Stakeholder Coordination & Support

  • Collaborate with operational stakeholders, project managers, technical teams, and Government leadership.

Modernization & Implementation Support

  • Support implementation activities associated with automation, systems modernization, and workflow transformation projects.

Bachelor’s degree in:

  • Public Administration
  • Management
  • Information Systems
  • Organizational Leadership

Equivalent professional experience may be considered where appropriate.

Required Experience

raw.description:
Mspark is a pioneering data & marketing technology company that bridges the gap between targeted marketing and real-world impact. We specialize in creating seamless, omni-channel experiences for consumers. Our platform integrates cutting-edge digital advertising across display, video, CTV, Meta, Google and DOOH with sophisticated, data-driven direct mail campaigns. We help the world’s top brands create a cohesive customer journey that drives measurable results online and offline.

About the Role

Project Phoenix is Mspark's new business operating system — a company-wide transformation spanning how we go to market, how we run our technology and systems, and how we operate day to day. This role sits at the center of that effort. The Program Manager is the connective tissue across Phoenix's three workstreams — Running the Business, Strategy and Planning, and Execution and Operations — ensuring the overall program moves forward as one coordinated effort rather than three parallel tracks.

Within Strategy and Planning specifically, Phoenix is anchored by three foundational initiatives we refer to internally as the Nirvana stages — the future-state systems that, once in place, give Mspark the operating foundation the rest of Phoenix builds on: the Rippling/Concur replacement, the Sage/Maestro replacement, and the Dynamics replacement. This role operates at both levels of the program: partnering with the three workstream owners at the strategic level and partnering directly with the owners of each Nirvana stage to keep those foundational initiatives on track and well-sequenced relative to one another.

This is a newly created position reporting directly to the CEO for the duration of Project Phoenix. It is designed for someone who can operate with real ownership at the intersection of planning, people, and communication. Depending on how the role and the company evolve, it may expand into a Chief of Staff position beyond the life of Phoenix — this is a role with significant room to grow alongside the company's needs.

What You'll Do

  • Own overall program planning for Project Phoenix — building and maintaining the master timeline, milestones, and dependencies across all three workstreams and the three Nirvana stages within Strategy and Planning.
  • Partner directly with each workstream owner (Running the Business, Strategy and Planning, and Execution and Operations) to track progress, surface risks early, and keep decisions moving at the pace the business needs.
  • Partner directly with the owners of each Nirvana stage — Rippling/Concur replacement, Sage/Maestro replacement, and Dynamics replacement — to track progress at the initiative level and ensure these foundational efforts stay coordinated with each other and with the broader Strategy and Planning workstream.
  • Identify where workstreams or Nirvana stages intersect or depend on one another and proactively resolve conflicts before they become execution problems.
  • Establish and run a consistent operating cadence for Phoenix — status reporting, leadership check-ins, and decision logs — so the CEO and workstream owners always have a current, accurate picture of where things stand.
  • Own company-wide communications about Phoenix, ensuring updates are clear, consistent, and delivered on a predictable rhythm across all levels of the organization.
  • Act as a trusted extension of the CEO on Phoenix — representing the CEO's priorities in working sessions they can't attend personally and flagging issues that need the CEO's direct attention.
  • Help translate high-level strategic direction into concrete plans, owners, and deadlines.

Qualification-What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience leading complex, cross-functional programs or projects, ideally through a period of significant organizational change.
  • Ability to connect authentically with people at every level of the organization — from the executive team to frontline staff — building the trust needed to get a straight answer from anyone.
  • Clear, direct communication, especially when challenges or issues arise. This person surfaces problems early and plainly rather than softening or delaying bad news.
  • No areas treated as off-limits or deflected elsewhere — this person engages directly with any part of the organization or any issue the program touches, rather than routing around difficulty.
  • Ability to hold the big picture of the overall transformation in view at all times, connecting individual workstream and Nirvana-stage decisions back to what Phoenix is ultimately trying to achieve.
  • Comfort operating close to executive leadership — someone who can synthesize ambiguous, fast-moving information into clear plans and clear communication.
  • Strong project management fundamentals: planning, sequencing, risk management, and status reporting, without being rigidly wedded to a single methodology.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to write for a whole-company audience as easily as for a small leadership room.
  • Discretion and judgment — this role will regularly have visibility into sensitive, not-yet-public information.
  • A bias toward action and follow-through; comfortable holding senior stakeholders accountable to commitments.
  • Experience with technology, systems implementations, or business transformation programs is a strong plus, though this role is about program leadership, not technical execution.

Why This Role Matters

Phoenix touches nearly every part of Mspark, and its success depends on more than good individual decisions in Sales, Technology Strategy, or Execution — it depends on those efforts staying connected, sequenced correctly, and communicated clearly to the entire company. This role exists to make sure that happens.

Growth Path

This role is scoped around Project Phoenix in the near term. As Phoenix matures and the company's needs evolve, there is a clear path for this position to expand into a broader Chief of Staff role supporting the CEO across the business.

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. *Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

About the role

As a Staff Backend Engineer, you will provide technical leadership across your team and adjacent teams, solving the highest-scope and most complex problems in your area. You will lead large, cross-cutting backend initiatives, drive our modular architecture strategy, and define the standards that let teams move faster without compromising quality, security, reliability, or operability.

This is a technical leadership role that combines deep backend expertise, systems judgment, product judgment, and influence across organizational boundaries. You will work with Product, Frontend, Infrastructure, Security, Data, Engineering Managers, and engineers across product groups, bringing subject matter expertise, and you will do it without relying on formal authority.

Why you’ll love this role

  • Leverage: Your work multiplies across teams. The platforms, standards, and architectural decisions you lead determine how quickly everyone else can ship.
  • Genuinely Hard Problems: You’ll lead the modernization of a large monolith toward modular, reusable, appropriately independent systems — at the scale of a platform used by millions of users.
  • Influence Without Bureaucracy: You’ll shape technical direction across teams through clear written proposals and decision records, and partner with Product and Engineering leadership on platform roadmap and investment trade-offs.
  • Frontier AI Work: You’ll lead adoption of AI-assisted and agentic engineering workflows and define the review, quality, security, and privacy guardrails that make them safe to rely on.
  • Autonomy: You’ll thrive in our remote-first, asynchronous organization, where clear written communication and self-direction are the pillars of success.

What you’ll do

  • Lead Cross-Cutting Initiatives: Lead the technical design and delivery of large backend initiatives that span teams, and identify and remove systemic bottlenecks across product and infrastructure groups.
  • Own Architecture Strategy: Drive modular backend, service, data, and platform architecture. Lead modernization of the monolith and legacy backends toward modular, reusable, and appropriately independently operated systems — while preventing fragmentation and service sprawl.
  • Set the Standards: Define and improve standards for APIs, contracts, compatibility, schema evolution, testing, security, performance, observability, operability, and maintainability — plus the build, test, deploy, release, rollback, and production-readiness practices needed to operate modular features safely.
  • Establish Shared Patterns: Create the patterns for dependency management, data ownership, eventing, failure isolation, service maturity, and operational documentation. Establish Go service patterns and Kubernetes operating practices where they matter to our production estate, and guide Rust adoption where it solves a real systems, security, performance, or supply-chain problem.
  • Own What You Build in Production: Take part in on-call and incident response for the systems your teams own, act as a technical escalation point during complex incidents, and turn what you learn into architectural and operational improvements that prevent recurrence.
  • Influence and Partner: Shape technical direction across teams without formal authority, and partner with Product and Engineering leadership on platform-level roadmap decisions and investment trade-offs.
  • Grow Engineers: Mentor Senior and Intermediate engineers, shepherd technical debt reduction and reusable patterns that improve throughput, and raise the technical capability of the wider team.
  • Lead AI Adoption: Lead team-level adoption of AI-assisted and agentic workflows, including the quality, security, privacy, and operational guardrails, and help engineers direct, validate, reject, and course-correct agent output.

What you’ll bring

  • Cross-Team Technical Leadership: A sustained record of technical leadership across more than one team or a broad product area.
  • Deep Architecture Experience: Deep backend architecture and production experience in complex applications, services, or platforms, including scaling or governing APIs, service platforms, data systems, modular monoliths, or shared backend components.
  • Modularization in Production: Experience modernizing a monolith or legacy backend architecture in production, and with modular architecture such as bounded contexts, package encapsulation, ports and adapters, service extraction, event-driven boundaries, or an equivalent approach.
  • Influence Without Authority: A strong ability to create alignment through clear written proposals and decision records, so decisions are documented, understood, and adopted without constant escalation.
  • Product Judgment: The ability to balance customer outcomes, delivery speed, technical health, reliability, and long-term platform investment.
  • Mentorship: Experience mentoring engineers and shaping standards through code review, documentation, and example.
  • Agentic AI Leadership: Production experience with AI-assisted or agentic engineering workflows, including the ability to evaluate and improve how a team adopts them.

Helpful experience

  • Go services and APIs at scale.
  • Kubernetes and cloud-native operations, including deployment, scaling, observability, rollback, and production readiness.
  • Rust adoption or production ownership for systems, security, performance, or platform components.
  • Ruby/Rails modularization and large-monolith modernization.
  • PostgreSQL scaling, data partitioning, queues, messaging, or distributed systems.
  • Security-sensitive product or software supply chain engineering.
  • Experience across SaaS, single-tenant, self-managed, or air-gapped deployment constraints.
