raw.description:
About Kraymer Art & Anime Studio

Kraymer Art started as a jewelry brand for people who take their fandom seriously, collector-grade pieces made for people who notice the details, and it's grown a loyal community along the way. We're now building out a new kind of anime studio alongside it, one built around the stories and creators that the indie community loves most, turning beloved manga, manhwa, and webcomics into fully produced anime for a passionate, fast-growing audience.

The Role

This is a ground-floor marketing seat spanning both sides of what we're building: an established brand with a loyal following, and a brand-new studio launching from zero. You are not coming in to run someone else's playbook. You're coming in to build the studio's presence from scratch, right alongside growing what's already working on the jewelry side.

To be specific: you'll be growing two things at once, KraymerTV (the anime studio's social presence, starting from zero) and Kraymer Art's existing jewelry channels.

We're looking for someone who has actually grown a social audience from nothing, who knows what real community-building, earned reach, and launch marketing looks like end to end, and who is genuinely excited to build both voices at once. This is a rare opportunity to have real ownership at a company that is still early enough that your fingerprints will be on everything we build.

What you'll own: Anime Studio / KraymerTV (build from zero)

  • Build KraymerTV's social presence from the ground up: content pillars, posting cadence, and a real content calendar across platforms, with the goal of growing followers, reach, and engagement from a standing start.
  • Plan and run an earned-reach strategy to get people talking: shareable hooks/mechanics, seeding relevant online communities, and sparking user-generated content and word of mouth (not just "boost the budget and hope").
  • Own the growth funnel at every stage, from pre-launch through launch and beyond: subscribe/waitlist offer, landing page copy, and signup flow, evolving as the studio moves from pre-launch to a real, growing audience.
  • Plan and help execute paid social ad campaigns: creative direction, copy, and overall ad strategy.
  • Partner with our email team/agency on a welcome and nurture email sequence for new subscribers.
  • Help shape and carry a single, consistent brand message across every touchpoint (social, landing page, email, ads) so the studio's launch feels unified rather than scattered.
  • Lay early community groundwork: identify where engaged fans are already showing up (comments, replies, shares) and how to nurture that ahead of future community spaces.
  • Exercise judgment on sensitive or brand-critical topics and flag anything that needs leadership sign-off before it goes public.

What you'll own: Kraymer Art / Jewelry

  • Manage and grow Kraymer Art's existing social channels (Instagram, YouTube), building on an established following.
  • Keep messaging consistent with the jewelry brand's voice (collector-grade, minimalist, design-led, craftsmanship-focused) while adapting tone appropriately when content crosses over with the anime studio.
  • Identify where the jewelry audience (Gen Z and younger millennials, fashion-forward anime/manga/gaming fans, largely US-based) overlaps with the anime studio's audience, and plan cross-promotion that grows both without alienating either.

How you'll work

  • We're a fully remote, async-first team, so clear and frequent communication is essential, not optional. You should be proactive about sharing progress, flagging blockers, and giving honest status updates without being chased.
  • Poor communication (going quiet, unclear updates, or surprises instead of early flags) is a dealbreaker for this role.
  • Comfortable owning two related but distinct brand voices at once and knowing when to keep them separate versus cross-pollinate.
  • High autonomy, high accountability: this role is about judgment and point of view, not just task execution. You'll be expected to bring recommendations, not just requests for direction.

What we're looking for

  • Genuine knowledge of and interest in anime/manga/manhwa, and fandom culture. You understand what these communities care about, how they talk, and what earns their trust, because you're already in the space or have marketed within it, not learning it from scratch on the job.
  • Proven experience growing a social media presence from zero: real examples of audience, reach, and engagement growth you can point to, not just managing an already-large account.
  • Experience with earned-reach or community-driven growth tactics (organic/UGC-driven), in addition to paid social advertising.
  • Strong copywriting instincts across formats: social captions, landing pages, ad creative, email.
  • Ability to juggle two brand identities and audiences under one company umbrella.
  • Excellent written communication and a track record of working well in a remote, async team; comfortable giving regular updates without prompting.
  • Startup mentality: comfortable with ambiguity, fast iteration, and building process as you go.
  • Nice to have: experience in jewelry or fashion e-commerce, or working directly with independent creators/IP.

Why Work With Us

  • Genuine Flexibility: We are results-oriented. As long as the work gets done at a fast pace and the KPIs are met, you manage your own schedule.
  • Long-term job: We're looking to hire someone full-time for this position for the long haul.
  • Fully remote: No more long hours stuck in commute, join our entire team who are fully remote.
  • Work within a fun industry of anime jewelry and accessories, something perfect for anime fans and/or jewelry enthusiasts.
  • Ground-floor ownership: Beyond growing an established jewelry brand, you'll get to build our brand-new anime studio's social presence from zero, real influence on something still taking shape from day one.

DATA ANALYST

Department: Finance and Administration

JOB SUMMARY

One More Child is seeking to employ a full-time Data Analyst to support its mission of impacting vulnerable children and struggling families through the collection, integration, analysis, forecasting, and visualization of organizational data. The Data Analyst will bridge the gap between raw data and actionable intelligence by leveraging Microsoft Fabric's unified analytics platform to transform data into strategic insights that improve decision-making across fundraising, finance, program operations, and organizational leadership.

This position will be responsible for analyzing data from multiple sources, developing semantic data models, identifying trends and opportunities, conducting predictive analysis, and delivering interactive Power BI dashboards that translate data into meaningful business insights. The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical skills, advanced Microsoft Fabric and Power BI expertise, and the ability to communicate complex data findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND FUNCTIONS

  • Design and maintain interactive dashboards, reports, and scorecards using Power BI
  • Monitor Fabric data pipelines and datasets and extend semantic models.
  • Perform trend analysis, forecasting, and predictive analytics to support organizational planning and decision-making.
  • Maintain reliable reporting systems that include data from multiple legacy organizational systems and new data systems as needed; identify inaccurate or inconsistent data and work with appropriate departments to cleanse data and resolve underlying issues.
  • Utilize SQL, Power BI, and Fabric analytics tools to identify insights, opportunities, risks, and performance trends.
  • Develop and support machine learning and predictive models using Microsoft Fabric Data Science tools, Spark and/or Python.
  • Maintain and respond to automated monitoring, alerts, and reporting solutions using Microsoft Fabric capabilities.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to define reporting requirements, KPIs, and analytical needs.
  • Develop report wireframes, mockups, or prototypes to validate layout, metrics, filters, and user experience prior to dashboard development.
  • Present data-driven recommendations and insights to leadership and department teams.
  • Support data governance, data quality, security, and reporting best practices across the organization.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • N/A


REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Statistics, Business Analytics, or a related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Three (3) or more years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, or a related field.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Power BI, including DAX, Power Query, data modeling, and dashboard development.
  • Ability to demonstrate data visualization capabilities in Power BI and provide examples of previous dashboard, report, or analytics work.
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric, including OneLake, and Data Warehouse.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience querying large datasets.
  • Working knowledge of Python, Spark, or other data science and analytics tools.
  • Knowledge of dimensional modeling, forecasting, statistical analysis, and predictive analytics methodologies.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to present technical information to non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, maintain data accuracy, and work effectively in a collaborative environment.
  • Preferred certifications: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate, Power BI Data Analyst Associate, Certified Analytics Professional or similar.
  • Preferred KQL experience

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • N/A

COMPETENCIES

SAP PRICING/INPUT ANALYST

THE POSITION IN A NUTSHELL

Sciens Building Solutions is seeking an experienced SAP Pricing/Input Analyst to support the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of pricing and related input data across the Sciens enterprise. This role is primarily administrative and detail-oriented, ensuring that supplier price books, standard parts pricing, one-off pricing requests, and other approved inputs are correctly prepared, validated, maintained, and communicated for use in SAP, SAP CPQ, estimating, purchasing, and related business processes.

The SAP Pricing/Input Analyst will work closely with procurement, finance, sales, estimating, operations, SAP master-data teams, Division stakeholders, and suppliers. The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable working with large volumes of data, and able to follow defined processes, while identifying discrepancies and escalating issues quickly. This role supports Sciens’ continued effort to standardize pricing practices and improve data quality across all Divisions nationwide.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING (and doing well!)

Pricing and Input Administration

  • Maintain accurate and current supplier price books, standard parts pricing, labor-related pricing inputs, and other approved pricing data used by Sciens Divisions.
  • Receive, organize, review, and prepare pricing updates for entry or upload into SAP and related systems.
  • Process one-off parts and pricing requests in accordance with established approval and documentation requirements.
  • Validate pricing inputs against supplier information, approved price books, effective dates, part numbers, descriptions, units of measure, and other required fields.
  • Track manufacturer and supplier pricing changes, discontinued items, new items, substitutions, and other updates that may affect estimating or purchasing.
  • Confirm that pricing changes are complete, accurate, appropriately supported, and ready for ERP-team processing.

SAP and Data Quality Support

  • Enter, maintain, and support pricing-related master data in SAP, SAP CPQ, or designated input templates and repositories.
  • Perform data-quality reviews to identify missing, duplicate, inconsistent, outdated, or incorrectly formatted pricing records.
  • Reconcile system pricing to supplier price books and approved source documentation; research and resolve discrepancies.
  • Maintain clear audit trails and documentation for pricing changes, approvals, effective dates, and follow-up items.
  • Coordinate with SAP master-data and ERP teams to submit approved updates and confirm successful processing.
  • Support data loads, testing, validation, and post-update reviews during SAP enhancements, releases, and Divisional go-lives.

Cross-Functional and Division Support

  • Serve as a reliable point of contact for Divisions and internal stakeholders regarding pricing inputs, data requirements, and update status.
  • Partner with Sciens procurement and suppliers to obtain current price books, pricing notices, product information, and supporting documentation.
  • Work with sales, estimating, finance, operations, and purchasing to understand how pricing data is used and identify downstream impacts.
  • Respond to questions and research pricing-related issues in a timely and professional manner.
  • Help communicate standardized procedures and reinforce consistent pricing-input practices across Sciens Divisions.
  • Prepare routine status reports, issue logs, reconciliation summaries, and other reporting requested by management.

Process Improvement and Compliance

  • Follow Sciens policies, procedures, internal controls, approval requirements, and data-governance standards.
  • Identify opportunities to improve pricing-input workflows, templates, controls, documentation, and reporting.
  • Support the development and maintenance of standard operating procedures and job aids for pricing administration.
  • Recommend practical process improvements that increase accuracy, reduce rework, and improve turnaround time.
  • Protect confidential supplier, pricing, financial, and company information.
  • Participate in special projects and perform other job-related duties as assigned.

WHAT WE LIKE ABOUT YOU

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, supply chain, information systems, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
  • Three to five years of experience in pricing administration, master data, purchasing, procurement operations, ERP support, data analysis, or a related function.
  • Experience working with SAP, SAP CPQ, another ERP system, or structured pricing/master-data processes.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including sorting, filtering, lookups, formulas, data validation, and reconciliation of large data sets.
  • Demonstrated ability to maintain accurate records and manage repetitive, detail-sensitive work with a high degree of consistency.
  • Ability to review source documentation, identify discrepancies, investigate root causes, and follow issues through resolution.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to work with suppliers, internal stakeholders, and technical teams.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively as part of a cross-functional team.
  • Positive, service-oriented approach and willingness to support stakeholders across a growing national organization.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience maintaining supplier price books, parts catalogs, material masters, labor rates, or similar commercial data.
  • Experience supporting SAP S/4HANA, SAP CPQ, SAP Ariba, SAP Materials Management, or related SAP processes.
  • Familiarity with purchasing, inventory, estimating, pricing, or procure-to-pay processes.
  • Experience with data-load templates, SAP Migration Cockpit, reporting tools, or data-governance practices.
  • Experience in the fire and life-safety, construction, service, distribution, or other multi-Division environment.
  • SAP certification or formal training in supply chain, procurement, finance, or data management.

WHAT WE’RE BRINGING TO THE TABLE

  • Competitive salary based on qualifications.
  • Paid time off plan and holidays.
  • 401(k) matching.
  • Short-term and long-term disability.
  • Medical, dental, and vision plans with options.
  • Life insurance.
  • Professional career development opportunities.
  • Tuition reimbursement program.

SAFER GAMBLING (SG) AGENT – Remote Part-time

Overview:

As our team continues to grow, we are seeking a Part-TimeSafer Gambling Agent to strengthen our responsible gambling initiatives. This role will be responsible for ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, promoting player protection, and developing strategies that support a safe and responsible gaming environment. The ideal candidate will have strong knowledge of safer gambling practices, regulatory frameworks, and customer risk management, along with the ability to collaborate across teams to drive a culture of responsible gaming throughout the organisation.

This is a remote, part-time role, requiring work every Saturday and Sunday, 14:00–22:00. Bank holiday cover may be required from time to time, in addition to your standard weekend shifts.

The role requires a dedicated home workspace and undivided attention throughout each shift. This is a busy, hands-on role and cannot be performed alongside other responsibilities.

Summary of the position:

We are seeking an enthusiastic and detail-oriented individual who works well both independently and as part of a team. This role will sit within the Safer Gambling Team, supporting the effective day-to-day delivery of our safer gambling policies, procedures, and customer protection initiatives under the guidance of the Safer Gambling Manager.

The successful candidate will be a confident and empathetic communicator, capable of engaging with customers sensitively on responsible gambling matters and conveying regulatory requirements clearly. They will handle customer interactions professionally, assess customer risk indicators, and take appropriate action in line with internal procedures and regulatory obligations.

A key part of this role is the delivery of high-quality, empathetic customer interactions, ensuring that customers who may be experiencing gambling-related harm are identified early, engaged with appropriately, and supported in line with regulatory expectations and QuinnBet's safer gambling framework.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement safer gambling policies and procedures in line with regulatory expectations and internal procedures
  • Maintain compliance with UKGC, Irish, and Gibraltar frameworks in all customer-facing activity
  • Conduct proactive and reactive customer interactions to identify and act on behavioural, affordability, and financial risk indicators
  • Review customer accounts and activity to identify patterns of concern, applying appropriate interventions including deposit limits, cooling-off periods, self-exclusion referrals, and GAMSTOP signposting
  • Complete affordability assessments and responsible gambling interactions in line with UKGC financial risk thresholds, escalating to the Safer Gambling Manager or Team Lead where enhanced review is required
  • Handle customer contacts relating to safer gambling, responsible gaming concerns, and self-exclusion requests in a professional, non-judgmental, and empathetic manner
  • Support the handling and resolution of safer gambling-related customer queries and complaints, escalating to the Safer Gambling Manager or team lead where appropriate
  • Maintain accurate and complete case records in the case management system, ensuring all customer interactions are documented with a recorded outcome, rational and next action
  • Receive quality assurance feedback from the Quality team and act on it promptly, working with the Safer Gambling Manager and Team lead to develop and improve performance
  • Support onboarding and continuous training by sharing knowledge and contributing to a consistent team approach
  • Support internal audits, regulatory reviews, and licensing requirements by maintaining audit-ready case files and documentation

Education and Experience Required.

  • A minimum of one year's experience in a related role, preferably in the gaming, financial services, or customer-facing compliance sector
  • Demonstrable understanding of UKGC safer gambling regulations, guidance, and expectations, or a willingness to develop this knowledge rapidly
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to prioritise and deliver in a fast-paced and dynamic environment with a high degree of personal accountability, integrity, and trust
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to assess customer risk indicators and apply sound, consistent judgment
  • High level of integrity, accountability, and discretion when handling sensitive customer information
  • Recognised relevant qualification is desirable; the company will support further certification if required
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in fluent English

What We Offer

  • Competitive renumeration
  • Ongoing professional development and training support
  • Opportunity to shape the Safer Gambling culture in a fast-growing, values-driven company
  • Support in obtaining relevant certifications and qualifications

About ACLED

Armed Conflict Location & Event Data (ACLED) is an independent, impartial conflict and protest monitoring organization providing real-time data and analysis on violent conflict and protest in all countries and territories across the world.

The consultancy opportunity

ACLED is looking for a Yemen Researcher to assist in the collection, review and management of political violence and protest data across Yemen. Researchers must be available for a minimum of 35 to 40hours per week. This opportunity is fully remote and can be done from any location with reliable internet service.

This is an entry-level, independent consultant opportunity, and may require submissions mid-week and on weekends.

This opportunity is open to nationals of any country. For more information, please review the Applicant FAQs.

Collection of data is conducted by reviewing news, international organization, NGO and security reports on a list of assigned countries, and recording the incidents of political violence into an Excel template. Researchers will focus on coding events to provide holistic coverage of current political violence, ranging from protests to battles.

Review and management of data involves ensuring the quality, consistency and reliability of the data produced. The researcher provides team members with experience conducting detail-oriented tasks, and producing and managing quantitative data.

Please note that this opportunity involves working with conflict-related media and reading about violent events.

Specific deliverables:

Candidates who are selected will undergo extensive ACLED training. The training consists of several exercises. Candidates' exercises will be scrutinized and only those who are delivering at the required level will be retained as Researchers.

Remuneration:

Remuneration is 20 USD per hour.

ACLED is seeking applicants who have the following skills and experience:

  • University degree in international relations, political science, conflict studies, peacebuilding, international development, or related field;
  • Familiarity with Excel (essential);
  • Fluency in English (essential);
  • Fluency in Arabic (essential);
  • Experience conducting desk-based research;
  • Experience working to deadlines with limited supervision;
  • A high level of attention to detail and ability to receive and incorporate feedback;
  • Research focus or professional experience in conflict research or peace-building in the Middle East generally, or country-specific studies is a strong advantage;
  • Familiarity with conflict and actors in the relevant countries;
  • Access to a computer, a reliable internet connection, email, and the Microsoft Office Suite.

In providing this suite of services, StationMD enables individuals with I/DD faster access to high-quality care and substantially reduces unnecessary medical costs.

StationMD is seeking an Information Security Analyst to serve as a core member of the Security Operations Center (SOC), responsible for monitoring, detecting, analyzing, and responding to cybersecurity threats and incidents. This role focuses on triaging security alerts, enhancing SIEM capabilities, and maintaining the organization's security monitoring infrastructure to protect against cyber threats.

  • Tune alert thresholds to reduce false positives while maintaining detection efficacy

Commensurate with experience

About Soum

Soum is Saudi Arabia's leading B2C marketplace for used electronics and used cars. In five years we have grown into a trusted platform for buyers and sellers across the Kingdom, combining rigorous quality standards with a technology-first approach. We are now scaling our cars vertical significantly, and we are looking for an exceptional B2C Sales Team Lead to drive that growth.

About the role

You will lead a B2C sales team responsible for acquiring new customers interested in purchasing cars, and for closing those deals. You will own the customer journey from lead generation and qualification through negotiation, closing, and completion of the sale — across both Cash and Financing journeys.

This is a player-coach position: you will lead and develop the team while stepping into challenging deals, supporting Sales Representatives with negotiations and objections, and closing important opportunities yourself.

Responsibilities:

    B2C sales & deal closing

    • Lead a B2C sales team acquiring new customers interested in purchasing cars.

    • Manage both Cash and Financing sales journeys.

    • Own the customer journey from lead generation and qualification through negotiation, closing, and completion of the sale.

    • Step into complex or high-value deals and close difficult opportunities.

    Lead management

    • Ensure leads are assigned across the team without delay and first contact happens within target response times.

    • Ensure consistent, disciplined follow-up on every open lead.

    • Ensure opportunities are actively progressed through each stage without unnecessary drop-offs.

    Sales funnel ownership

    • Own and monitor conversion across the full sales funnel, from lead generation and qualification through booking, Cash/Financing, closing, and completed sale.

    • Funnel stages: Lead → Contacted → Qualified → Booking → Cash/Financing → Closing → Completed Sale.

    • Track stage-to-stage conversion rates, identify where deals stall, and act on the drop-off points.

    Customer qualification

    • Qualify customers into the Cash or Financing journey based on their needs, affordability, and basic financing eligibility indicators.

    • Coach the team to qualify accurately at first contact so deals do not stall later in the funnel.

    • Leave the final credit decision to the financing partner.

    Customer journey & cross-functional coordination

    • Ensure a smooth customer journey across Sales, Operations, Supply/Showroom, Finance, and other relevant functions.

    • Identify blockers affecting the customer or the Sales team, communicate with the relevant department, and follow the issue through to resolution.

    Team leadership & coaching

    • Daily and weekly performance management.

    • Coaching and development of Sales Representatives.

    • Call quality and sales technique reviews.

    • Pipeline management.

    • KPI and target management.

    • Performance improvement plans where required.

    • Regular 1:1s and team reviews.

    Reporting & forecasting

    • Own weekly and monthly reporting on sales performance, target achievement, conversion rates, pipeline health, forecasting, key blockers, action plans, and team productivity.

    • Use the data to identify gaps, make decisions, and improve team performance — not simply prepare reports.

    CRM & sales process discipline

    • Maintain CRM discipline across the team: accurate stage management, notes, follow-ups, pipeline hygiene, and forecasting.

    • Provide clear visibility on where every opportunity stands and what is required to move it toward closing.

    Escalation, problem solving & ownership

    • Act as the first escalation point for Sales Representatives when customer or deal-related issues require cross-functional support.

    • Take ownership of blocked deals: identify the root cause, engage the relevant department, and follow up until resolved.

    • Resolve blockers across customer issues, financing, operations, vehicle-related matters, showroom coordination, and payments.

Qualifications:

    Must have

    •4+ years of sales experience.

    •1–2+ years leading a sales team.

    •Proven track record of hitting acquisition, conversion, and closing targets in B2C sales.

    •Experience closing both cash and financed deals.

    •Strong spoken and written English.

    •Fluent / native-level Urdu.

    •Able to confidently understand and communicate vehicle specifications, features, benefits, and value propositions across Japanese, Korean, American, and Chinese brands.

    •Working knowledge of automotive financing and credit concepts, including how banks and financing companies assess eligibility.

    •Able to qualify customers for Cash and Financing journeys based on needs, affordability, and basic eligibility indicators.

    •Strong CRM discipline and the ability to build and defend a forecast.

    •Experience managing and coaching a team remotely.

    •Based in Pakistan and available Sunday–Thursday on Riyadh hours.

    Good to have

    •Automotive retail, used cars, or auto financing background.

    •Marketplace or classified experience.

    •Gulf market experience, or selling to expatriate customer segments.

    •Working Arabic.

    •Startup or scale-up experience.

raw.description:
Senior Data Analyst (LTV / Predictive Analytics)

StellarTech is a B2C mobile publisher in EdTech: subscription apps, in-app monetization and performance marketing at scale. LTV prediction is how we decide where to invest, and the forecasting pipeline is already live. We are opening this role to have one senior analyst own its accuracy and its evolution. This is research and predictive analytics, not reporting: everything that can be standardised is already automated by Data Engineering, so the work is hypotheses, factor analysis and improvements to the prediction algorithm itself. You report to the Head of the Operational Department and work directly with Product, UA, Finance and Data Engineering.

What you will do

  • Own and develop the LTV prediction algorithm: find the parameters and factors that increase forecast accuracy, prototype improvements in SQL, measure the gain, then hand the logic over to Data Engineering.
  • Validate forecasts on closed cohorts, monitor forecast quality over time and explain where exactly a model deviates from actual LTV.
  • Research what moves LTV: product features, segments, purchase sources (for example, purchases coming through CRM vs other sources), and adapt the prediction logic to them.
  • Run analytical research end to end, from a vague question to a documented recommendation for Product, UA and Finance: where payback improves, where to concentrate media buying, what changes unit economics at company level.
  • Automate analytical routines and model quality monitoring together with Data Engineering.

Requirements

Critical

  • 4+ years in Data Analyst / Senior Data Analyst / Product Analyst roles with a product analytics focus: measuring the impact of factors on business metrics, not marketing attribution.
  • Strong SQL: complex queries, window functions, optimisation. Here SQL is the main instrument for prototyping and testing the algorithm.
  • Solid mathematical statistics and understanding of how ML models work: you can build and validate a forecast, judge model quality (MAE, RMSE, MAPE, R2), run factor analysis and explain where a model broke.
  • Product background with in-app monetization and its economics: LTV, cohorts, retention, ROI, CAC, ARPU, payback. Subscriptions are ideal; other in-app B2C models also work. Ad-only monetization is a different pattern and is not a fit.
  • A proven end-to-end pattern: you take a vague question, form a hypothesis, dig into it and bring it to a recommendation. There is no micromanagement here and almost no standard tasks.
  • Ability to back conclusions with data and to communicate them to both technical and business stakeholders.

Non-critical

  • Python (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn) for analysis and modelling: welcome, but not a blocker if the statistical and analytical thinking is there.
  • A/B testing and statistical hypothesis testing.
  • BI tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI).
  • Cloud DWH and large data volumes (Athena, BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift or similar).

Will be a plus

  • Feature engineering and model interpretation (SHAP, feature importance).
  • Mobile products, gaming or subscription businesses.
  • Our stack: Amazon Athena, S3-based DWH, CatBoost, Tableau, Git, Jupyter.

Why You'll Love Working With Us

  • Impactful Work: Your contributions will directly shape the future of our company.
  • Innovative Environment: We're all about trying new things and pushing the envelope in EdTech.
  • AI solutions
  • Wealth: We offer a competitive salary.
  • Balance: Flexible paid time off, you get 21 days of annual leave + 10 bank holidays.
  • Collaborative Culture: Work alongside passionate professionals who are as driven as you are.

Hiring process

  • Intro call with the recruiter.
  • Technical interview: SQL, statistics and ML fundamentals, plus an analytical case on how you build a plan to investigate a problem.
  • Final interview with the department head. Optionally, a 30-minute culture fit conversation with HRBP.

If this is the kind of work you want to own, send us your CV. We will come back to you with the next step.
